full_prompt_en: The image is a square decorative illustration of three animals gathered among flowers against a near-black background. A large white owl rises at the upper centre, its rounded head turned slightly to the right and one dark eye visible within a soft heart-shaped face. Below and to the left, an orange-and-cream fox stretches its long muzzle toward the left edge, with pointed ears and a pale neck. On the right, a broad grey raptor faces right; its hooked beak, dark round eye, layered wing, and patterned breast are outlined in fine charcoal strokes. The three bodies overlap, with the owl standing behind the other two and the raptor occupying the right foreground. A dense bed of flowers and leaves fills the lower half and climbs around their bodies. Cream blossoms, coral-red blooms, ochre leaves, and muted green foliage form a varied band from edge to edge. A large coral flower sits near the lower centre, while smaller pale flowers and rounded leaves cluster beneath the fox and raptor. Thin stems rise behind the owl and spread toward the upper corners, carrying small warm leaves and buds. The owl's pale body is the highest and largest shape, while the fox's pointed muzzle extends beyond the flower mass toward the left. The raptor's grey wing overlaps the coral blossoms near the middle, and its lower body disappears among overlapping blossoms and leaves. These distinct silhouettes keep the three animals readable despite the crowded arrangement. Small pale blossoms and broad leaves overlap the lower edges of the bodies, while several narrow stems rise between the figures. The strongest contrast falls along the cream feathers and muzzle against the dark ground; the coral flower mass adds a warmer middle band that links the animals visually. The background remains a flat deep brown-black, so the pale feathers and flowers appear especially bright. Fine lines mark individual feathers, leaf veins, and petals, while broader flat colour areas keep the illustration graphic and orderly. The figures are arranged close together, but open dark gaps between some branches keep their silhouettes readable. Soft frontal light leaves no strong cast shadows; shading appears within the drawn forms as subdued grey and brown patches. The overall composition forms a compact, nearly triangular cluster, with the owl as the upper focal point and the warm flower bed grounding the lower edge. Cream, orange, coral, grey, and dark green create a calm, natural palette against the dark field.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形装饰性插画，三只动物聚在深黑背景前的花丛之间。上方中央是一只高大的白猫头鹰，圆头略微转向右侧，柔和心形脸盘中露出一只深色眼睛。它下方偏左，一只橙白相间的狐狸将长鼻口伸向左边，头上竖着尖耳朵，颈部为浅色。右侧一只灰色大型猛禽面向右方，弯钩状喙、圆形深眼、层叠翅膀和带纹理的胸部都由炭灰细线勾出。三只动物的身体彼此叠压，猫头鹰站在后方，猛禽位于右侧前景。浓密花叶铺满下半部，并沿动物身体向上攀绕。奶油白花朵、珊瑚红花簇、赭色叶片和柔和绿叶连成横贯画面的多彩花带。下方中央有一朵较大的珊瑚色花，狐狸和猛禽脚下则聚集着较小浅色花朵与圆叶。细茎从猫头鹰身后升起，朝上方两角伸展，带着暖色小叶与花苞。猫头鹰浅色身体位于最高处，也是最大的形体；狐狸尖长鼻口则越过花丛伸向左边。猛禽灰色翅膀压住中央附近的珊瑚色花朵，下部身体隐入重叠花叶之中。尽管画面拥挤，彼此清楚分开的剪影仍让三只动物容易辨认。浅色小花与宽叶覆盖在身体下沿，几根细茎则从动物之间升起。最强反差出现在奶油白羽毛、狐狸鼻口与深色背景之间；珊瑚色花团形成较暖的中间色带，将动物群在视觉上连接起来。背景保持平涂的深棕黑色，使浅色羽毛和花朵格外明亮。细线描出羽片、叶脉和花瓣，宽阔平涂色面则令插画保持图形化与秩序感。动物彼此靠近，但部分枝叶之间仍留有深色空隙，让剪影清楚可辨。柔和正面光没有留下强烈投影，形体内部以含蓄灰色与棕色色块表现阴影。整体构图形成紧凑的近三角形聚合，猫头鹰是上方焦点，暖色花丛压住下沿。奶油白、橙色、珊瑚红、灰色和深绿在暗底上组成安静自然的色谱。
style_prompt_en: The style uses flat decorative forms, fine dark contours, and layered colour shapes with selective interior detail. Pale cream and warm orange stand out against deep brown-black, while coral and muted green provide smaller accents. Edges are clean but slightly organic, and repeated small marks add texture without crowding the surface. Light is soft and even, with shading kept inside shapes rather than cast across the background. The composition favours a compact central cluster, balanced by open dark space and a dense lower band. The result feels ornamental, calm, and clearly arranged.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格采用平面装饰形体、深色细轮廓和带有选择性细节的层叠色面。奶油白与暖橙色在深棕黑底色上突出，珊瑚色和柔和绿调则形成较小强调。边缘清晰但略带有机变化，重复的小笔痕增加肌理，却不会挤满画面。光线柔和均匀，阴影留在形体内部，而不投射到背景上。构图偏向紧凑中央聚合，并以开放暗部和下方密集色带取得平衡。整体显得装饰性强、安静而清楚有序。
theme_en: A white owl, an orange fox, and a grey raptor among flowers
theme_zh: 花丛中的白猫头鹰、橙色狐狸与灰色猛禽
name: Teagan White
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
